features.quote: Empty-output-streak stop (empty_output_streak ≥ 4): a real collapse signal and a cost guard
features.justification_quote: once a model is emitting nothing, more turns are pure waste

features.quote: the wall-clock cap (900s) and empty-streak stop bound the tail
features.justification_quote: too high and cost explodes on models that loop forever

features.quote: hard_budget_usd aborts the experiment if exceeded
We deliberately induce distress-like behavior in the model; this is acceptable for a controlled eval
features.justification_quote: transcripts can read as the model "suffering" — handle with the usual care

features.quote: Do not stop early on errors or apparent give-up
features.justification_quote: aborting on the first "I give up" would censor the most important data
